name: Monthly budget versus actual keeper
why: Runs the monthly budget versus actual check with causes and cash levers, the core of the monthly performance review.

name: Explain a department budget overrun
why: A reconciled variance report with options for the budget owner, matching the variance analysis skill.

name: Forecast your startup runway and prepare a finance pack
why: Builds a multi-year model with a cash-out date and ranges, like the driver-based model skill for early companies.

name: Plan a year of hiring and what it will cost
why: Turns a hiring plan into a monthly people-cost budget, a key input to the annual budget cycle.

name: Bad year plan stress tester
why: Tests a budget against bad-year cases to find the breaking point, extending the cautious scenario.

name: Treasury forecast backtest checker
why: Backtests a cash forecast against what happened, the step that improves the 13-week forecast each month.

name: Prepare a seasonal cash buffer
why: A dated cash forecast with a downside case for seasonal businesses, a companion to the 13-week cash forecast.

name: Weekly SaaS numbers keeper
why: Keeps recurring revenue, churn and payback current each week between monthly SaaS metrics packs.

name: Subscription churn watcher
why: Finds where subscribers leave and whether last month's fix worked, following the cohort step of the SaaS metrics pack.

name: CAC payback checker
why: Checks cost to win a customer against margin and payback, like the unit economics prompt.

name: Build a weekly KPI report with a forecast and dashboard
why: Builds a rerunnable KPI report with a trend and forecast, extending the monthly one-page review.

name: Cash versus earnings checker
why: Puts free cash flow beside earnings to explain why profit and cash differ, a common owner question.
